ns2:course.label: Undergraduate Seminar
ns2:course.description: Group discussion on a special topic in a field of study directly pertaining to subject matter in food science and human nutrition. Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same or subsequent terms to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Approved for letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same or subsequent terms to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore or Junior class standing. Restricted to BS:Fd Sci & Hmn Nutrn-FS -UIUC or BS:F Sci&Hm Ntr-Ind&Bus -UIUC.
